0.3464 Harmonic Invariant (Collatz proof attempt)

Brandon defines Hi=√3/5≈0.3464 as a proposed Lyapunov-style quantity for Collatz/Syracuse orbits, with Mirror Gate Ω=202/121≈1.669. Catalog as a proof ATTEMPT with claimed π benchmarking—needs independent verification; do not treat as settled math.

glossary

ARA Garage Experiment Build Book (GX-PL-01)

A falsifiable garage-lab protocol: start with a Michelson interferometer and a 50 g gold-coated tungsten mass on a sand-filled cinder-block bench, then (if Stage 1 works) move toward UHV + ⁸⁷Rb BEC. Predicted phase Δφ=16.08 rad with a clear null criterion. Written so a determined builder can buy used parts (~$6k Stage 1).

invention Concept / Experiment

ARA Inertia-Cell (IC-PP-01) draft patent package

DRAFT for attorney review — not filed. Proposes modulating inertial mass of a coherent cavity via a harmonic scalar Φ_H tied to holographic-screen thickness ℓ_H≈87.953 μm, while leaving classical gravitational mass alone. Includes ambitious Earth–Mars transfer numbers. Catalog as theoretical draft with explicit kill-tests, not as demonstrated hardware.

invention Concept / Experiment

ARA NIAC Phase I Concept (90-day Mars study draft)

DRAFT for NSPIRES — not submitted. Asks nine months to kill-or-keep one number (Δφ=16.08 rad) via Stage-1 garage optics / Yukawa residual, then budget an inertia-cell energy plan against Kilopower. Explicitly a kill-test proposal.
